# SolTrace — Complete System Reference for Language Models

SolTrace is an open-source AI assistant and on-chain blockchain investigator specialized for the Solana network.

Developed by **promisedkillua** (<https://www.promisedkillua.sbs/>).
Hosted live at <https://soltracer.vercel.app/>.
Open-source code available at <https://github.com/collinstheegod376/SOL-TRACER>.

---

## 1. System Overview

Traditional blockchain explorers like Solscan display dense tables of raw hex data, lamport amounts, and internal instruction logs that require specialized developer knowledge to decipher.

SolTrace bridges this gap by combining:
1. High-throughput Solana Mainnet RPC node integration (`@solana/web3.js`).
2. Groq Llama-3.3-70B and OSS reasoning models for conversational parsing and synthesis.
3. Deterministic analytics engine for flow visualization, DEX swap decoding, drainer vulnerability audits, and multi-hop counterparty tracing.
4. Minimalist, light-mode user experience optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile.

---

## 2. Query Classification & Architecture

Every incoming natural language prompt is categorized by an intelligent classification router into one of eight distinct pipelines:

1. `CONVERSATIONAL`: General user greetings, questions about capabilities, system intro, or chit-chat.
2. `LOOKUP`: Point queries for SOL balances, account owner programs, or token holdings.
3. `ENRICHMENT`: Joins balance lookups with token valuations (USD prices) and wallet classification.
4. `AGGREGATION`: Groups and ranks counterparties by transaction frequency and volume.
5. `FLOW_DIAGRAM`: Generates Mermaid-compatible 3-column diagrams (Senders -> Target -> Recipients).
6. `SECURITY_AUDIT`: Checks account authority, delegated token allowances, suspicious phishing tokens, and failure rates to generate a 0-100% Safety Score.
7. `DEX_TRADES`: Identifies and tabulates decentralized exchange swaps across Raydium, Jupiter, Orca, Meteora, and Pump.fun.
8. `MULTI_HOP`: Recursively follows outbound transfers 2-3 hops away to detect destination CEX deposit wallets.
